om: Felen som SwingLab letar efter (BESLUT B6), och måtten som granskningen visar vid P-positionerna utan att vara fel (BESLUT B32). Läses av appen (SwingLabKit) och PC:n (tools/pc/katalog.py). Fälten står i docs/FORMAT.md, bedömningen i docs/METOD.md M27. En källa är ej kontrollerad (kontrollerad: false) tills den lästs i original (BESLUT B10); research 5 läste dem 2026-10-23, och gränserna står i BESLUT B45. Listan spridning är passets spridning mellan slagen för ett mått (METOD M44).

fel.namn: Sway: the pelvis slides away from the target in the backswing
fel.ovning: Stick in the ground outside the trail hip. Swing to the top and stop: the hip turns, the stick stays put. Then feet together, 3/4 swings.
fel.notering: Sportsbox Pelvis Sway har samma definition, nollpunkt och tecken som M15: tour vid P4 −1,5 cm med driver, 0,0 med järn. Låg handicap nära 0, hög "flera tum" bort (golf.com). Gränsen är ett antagande byggt på de två, och båda klubbornas tour-tal är gröna (BESLUT B45).
fel.vad: How far the hip center moves along the target line from address to the top.
fel.varfor: Shows a slide away from the target in the backswing (sway).

fel.ovning: Swing to a metronome or a Tour Tempo beat: three counts up, one down.
fel.tanke: The club meets the ball on the third beat.
fel.notering: Låg prioritet: kvoten skiljer inte nivåer, amatörer har också medel 3,0 (Grober 2006). Nedsvingens tid visas bredvid (kortets tider, nedsving_s vid P7). Utanför grönt är gult, aldrig rött (BESLUT B45, METOD M5).
fel.vad: Backswing time divided by downswing time, from the start, the top and the impact click.
fel.varfor: Shows the rhythm of the swing; tempo has no proven link to the result.

fel.namn: Early extension: the pelvis moves toward the ball
fel.ovning: Glutes against a chair behind you at address. Slow swings that keep contact through impact while the pelvis rotates.
fel.tanke: The chair stays in contact all the way.
fel.notering: Sportsbox Pelvis Thrust har samma definition, nollpunkt och tecken som M7: ideal −2,3…+4,3 cm (en man av DeChambeaus storlek), tour vid träff +1,3 cm (SD 3,6), klubban anges inte. Grönt upp till idealets övre gräns, rött över tour-medel + 2 SD. TPI:s exempel (> 7,6 cm) tas inte in (BESLUT B45).
fel.vad: How far the hips move toward the ball from address to impact.
fel.varfor: Moving toward the ball is early extension.

fel.namn: Loss of posture: the chest rises
fel.ovning: Same as early extension: the chair behind your glutes, and your head below a line on the wall in front of you.
fel.tanke: The ball sees the top of your cap all the way.
fel.notering: Egen baslinje: Sportsbox Chest Bend är bröstkorgen i 3D (tour-tappet +4° med driver, +1° med järn), inte linjen höftmitt–axelmitt i bild, och felet i 2D är större än tappet. Spridningen mellan slagen hängde ihop med score, medlet inte (Yamamoto 2023, METOD M44, BESLUT B45).
fel.vad: How much the forward bend of the hip-to-shoulder line drops from address to impact.
fel.varfor: The chest rising from address to impact is loss of posture.

fel.namn: Too little hip shift from the top
fel.ovning: The step drill: feet together at address, step toward the target with the lead foot as the backswing changes direction. Ten reps with a short iron, no ball.
fel.notering: Egen baslinje. Ur Sportsbox Pelvis Sway blir resan toppen → träffen +13,0 cm med driver och +12,2 med järn (METOD M21); GolfTEC mäter svanskotan och jämförs inte. Sway bakåt och för lite förskjutning framåt är samma tema, bäckenets väg (PLAN S1).
fel.vad: How far the hip center moves toward the target from the top to impact.
fel.varfor: Shows how far the hips shift toward the target in the downswing (too little hip shift).

fel.ovning: Feet together, 3/4 swings: the slide that feeds the fault disappears.
fel.tanke: The belt buckle beats the cap to the target.
fel.notering: Sportsbox Sway Gap är avståndet, − = bröstet bakom; M19 är ändringen från adressen med motsatt tecken. Tour vid träff +13,2 cm (driver), +8,9 cm (järn): gränsen beror på klubban, så egen baslinje, lägre är sämre (BESLUT B45).
fel.vad: Hip sway minus chest sway at impact, both from address.
fel.varfor: Shows how far the chest stays behind the hips at impact (sway gap).

fel.ovning: Set up with the side bend that impact requires.
fel.tanke: The trail shoulder below the lead shoulder.
fel.notering: Avstängd tills S0 är klar (METOD M17). Referensen är 22–25° med järn (Sportsbox Chest Side Bend 22°, Meister S-faktor 25 ± 3° med järn 5), inte GolfTEC:s 39°, och 2D underskattar sidböjningen vid träff (Mears, 8,7°).
fel.vad: The angle of the shoulder line to level at impact, face on.
fel.varfor: Shoulder line in the picture, not the chest's side bend; under review.

fel.namn: Reverse spine: the upper body leans toward the target at the top
fel.ovning: Feet together (removes the slide that feeds the fault), and TPI’s Reach Over the Fence.
fel.tanke: The cap stays behind the ball at the top.
fel.notering: Negativ sidböjning i toppen = mot målet = reverse spine (METOD M14). TPI:s definition är läst i original, utan tal (research 5c).
fel.vad: The lean of the hip-to-shoulder line from vertical at the top, face on.
fel.varfor: Leaning toward the target at the top is reverse spine.

fel.namn: Chicken wing: the lead elbow folds after impact
fel.ovning: Half swings toward the 4:30 path, with the lead wrist flexed (motorcycle) through impact.
fel.tanke: The clubhead passes the hands after the ball.
fel.notering: Inga tal vid träff i källorna; egen baslinje. TPI:s definition är läst i original (research 5c).
fel.vad: Lead elbow bend just after impact, shoulder to elbow to wrist.
fel.varfor: A lead elbow that folds after impact is the chicken wing.

fel.namn: Flying elbow: the trail elbow points out at the top
fel.ovning: No swing drill found. Test 90/90 (trail shoulder external rotation) first: if it is limited, it is mobility.
fel.tanke: A towel under the trail arm stays in place to the top.
fel.vad: Trail upper arm angle from vertical at the top, shoulder to elbow, down the line.
fel.varfor: A trail elbow pointing out at the top is the flying elbow.

fel.namn: Over the top: the hands move out in the downswing
fel.ovning: A headcover outside and slightly behind the ball. If you hit it, the club came from outside.
fel.notering: Ingen gräns i cm hittad; TPI:s förekomst (43,5 %) kommer från en klinik utan källa (research 5c). Handens bana, inte klubbans, tills S7.
fel.vad: How far outside the backswing path the hands come down, at three heights.
fel.varfor: Hands moving out toward the ball in the downswing is over the top.

fel.namn: Bent lead arm at the top
fel.ovning: Swing to the top and stop against a wall behind you: the clubhead reaches the wall with a straight arm, not a bent one.
fel.tanke: The clubhead far from your head at the top.
fel.notering: För en vänsterspelare är det högerarmen (främre). GolfTEC: 76° mot 10° är en demonstratör, ingen norm (läst i original, research 5c).
fel.vad: Lead elbow bend at the top, shoulder to elbow to wrist.
fel.varfor: Shows a bent lead arm at the top.

matt.varfor: Shows how the hips recenter after sliding away in the backswing.

matt.vad: Time from the top until the hip center is back at its address position on the way to the target.
matt.varfor: Shows when in the downswing the hips shift toward the target.

matt.vad: The lowest point of the hip center between the top and impact, from address.
matt.varfor: Shows how far the hips drop in the downswing.

matt.varfor: Shows how far the hips drop in the downswing.

matt.varfor: Shows the hips rising into impact.

matt.varfor: Shows the hips rising into impact.

matt.vad: The lean of the hip-to-shoulder line from vertical in the finish, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows how far the upper body leans away from the target in the finish.

matt.vad: Time from the top to the impact click.
matt.varfor: Shows how long the downswing takes; tempo divides the backswing by it.

matt.vad: The angle of the shaft, grip to clubhead, to level in the picture, from the points you marked.
matt.varfor: Shows where the club points at each position; down the line the shaft is foreshortened when it points at the camera.
matt.tecken: 0 = level toward the ball · + clubhead above the grip

matt.vad: The angle to the ground of the line through the clubhead and the grip at address, from the points you marked.
matt.varfor: Shows the shaft plane line that the clubhead at P6 is compared with.

matt.vad: The angle of the shaft at the top to where a shaft parallel to the target line points in the picture: its center.
matt.varfor: Shows the shaft pointing across the line or laid off at the top; in 2D an estimate.

matt.vad: The angle at the address clubhead from the address shaft line to the clubhead at P6, in the picture.
matt.varfor: Shows the club above or below the address shaft plane at P6.

matt.vad: The angle of the shaft, grip to clubhead, to level in the picture, from the points you marked.
matt.varfor: Shows where the club points at each position.
matt.tecken: 0 = level toward the target · + clubhead above the grip

matt.vad: The angle of the shaft, grip to clubhead, to level at the top, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows the shaft short of or past parallel at the top.

matt.vad: The angle between the lead arm, wrist to shoulder, and the shaft, grip to clubhead, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows how much wrist hinge is kept in the downswing; an early increase is casting.
matt.tecken: 180° = arm and shaft in line · smaller = more hinge

matt.vad: The angle between the lead arm, wrist to shoulder, and the shaft, grip to clubhead, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows how much wrist hinge is kept in the downswing; an early increase is casting.
matt.tecken: 180° = arm and shaft in line · smaller = more hinge

matt.vad: The lean of the shaft, clubhead to grip, from vertical at impact, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows the shaft leaning toward or away from the target at impact.

spridning.vad: The spread of the spine angle at address between the swings in the session.
spridning.varfor: Shows how much the spine angle at address varies from swing to swing.
spridning.tecken: Degrees, robust standard deviation; 0 = the same every swing

spridning.vad: The spread of the spine angle at impact between the swings in the session.
spridning.varfor: Shows how much the spine angle at impact varies from swing to swing.
spridning.tecken: Degrees, robust standard deviation; 0 = the same every swing
